aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域，共有 2 条紧急事件需要关注。热点议题包括：Brazen attack on Niger’s airport；African Union condemns deadly Niamey；Sexual violence surges in Mozambique's。本日共收录 9 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: Brazen attack on Niger’s airport shows jihadis are expanding to cities in Africa's Sahel
articles.description: Gunfire and explosions at Niger’s main international airport highlight a shift in militant strategy in Africa’s Sahel region

articles.title: African Union condemns deadly Niamey airport attack, pledges support to Niger
articles.description: The African Union has condemned the terrorist attack on the Diori Hamani International Airport and an adjacent military base in Niamey, Niger .

articles.title: Sexual violence surges in Mozambique's Cabo Delgado as war grinds on
articles.description: Just before dawn one morning in March 2021, gunfire woke Olessa Ibrahimou as armed men stormed her village near Palma in northern Mozambique .

articles.title: Comparison to Hitler, Mao, Stalin? Trump says: ‘Sounds good to me!’

articles.title: US to end Pepfar funding of South Africa's HIV programmes
articles.description: The US says South Africa is not doing enough to protect the white-minority Afrikaner community.

articles.title: The Northern Gaze on Nuhu Ribadu: Security, Politics, and the Weight of Expectation
articles.description: When Nuhu Ribadu stood at the podium of the Ladi Kwali Hall in January 2006, he was still the celebrated chairman of the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission .

articles.title: Israel and Hezbollah agree to renew ceasefire after conflict threatens to derail US-Iran talks
articles.description: Israel and Hezbollah have agreed to renew a ceasefire, sources told CNN, as fighting in Lebanon threatens to derail negotiations between the US and Iran. Follow live updates.
